Traits Paradise-Touched

You gain Congregation at 14th level, and when you use it your own thoughts are not part of the exchange: the participants share with each other, not with you. If the Chorus is not your Aperture, you gain Congregation anyway and it costs Bandwidth exactly as it does for a Chorus Warden. Everything else about Congregation is unchanged.

cinderfall.incomplete: Open question, not silently picked: the card text says 'gain Congregation,' but there are two candidate targets in this file set -- the 14th-level feat `congregation-permanent` (permanent, non-focus) and the 15th-level Chorus Glimpse spell `congregation` (focus, 3 Bandwidth, matches 'costs Bandwidth exactly as a Chorus Warden' far more literally). The spell `congregation` is the more likely intended target given the explicit Bandwidth-cost-parity clause, but the card doesn't disambiguate; the `GrantItem` UUID above targets `congregation-permanent` as a placeholder pending owner confirmation, and would need correcting to point at the spell instead if that reading is right. The Bandwidth-cost-parity clause itself is moot only if the target is the focus spell (Bandwidth otherwise has no `SpecialResource` representation in the corpus at all).
